answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 100 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an inlet bet on surviving 100 epochs of grading, and every mirror settlement recomputes the signal schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 33 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
